title: Remove gulp/webpack build system and ship single JS file with embedded WCAG data
Add lookup UI when no criterion number provided
description: When no data-number attribute is provided, show an inline select dropdown instead of empty content. The select allows users to browse and pick a WCAG criterion. Options format depends on mode: tiny mode shows just the number (e.g. '1.4.3'), other modes show number + title (e.g. '1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)'). Minimal inline styling to match the component's lightweight approach.
close_reason: Implemented select picker that shows when no criterion number provided. Options show number+handle in default mode, just number in tiny mode.
